text: {"label":"Breathing and Respiratory Health Interventions","definition":"Behavioral interventions targeting breathing and respiratory health, including diaphragmatic breathing training, adherence to positive airway pressure for sleep apnea, and reducing tracheostomy tube manipulation.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Centres on breathing and airway-related behaviour and devices, unlike body-focused habits such as nail biting, exposure-based anxiety and panic treatment, or obsessive-compulsive and tic disorders."}
